title: Analysis code and data for "Contact-dependent intercellular dTMP transfer sustains tumor cell proliferation"
description: Analysis scripts and source data for the five bioinformatics Methods sections of Contact-dependent intercellular dTMP transfer sustains tumor cell proliferation: human A549 bulk RNA-seq differential expression analysis, single-cell classification analysis (GSE148071), Visium spatial neighborhood analysis, spatial deconvolution and cell-state co-abundance analysis using cell2location and NMF, and Kras/Trp53 amplicon gene-editing and mutation analysis. Each analysis folder records inputs, provenance and execution limits. MIT applies to laboratory-authored code; third-party code and scientific data retain their original terms.
